bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to search at Ryman Auditorium. Oversized bags and backpacks are prohibited.
prohibited: Cameras with telephoto or zoom lenses
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Self-parking is available directly across the street at Fifth + Broadway. Parking can be purchased upon entering the garage. The Ryman does not have a public parking lot.

rideshare.note: Let Lyft be your ride to the action! Use code RYMANAUD for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: Ryman Auditorium offers a variety of concessions including popcorn, candy, and pretzels available in the lobby on each floor. Fully stocked bars are also available for drinks. Nearby, Ole Red and Category 10 provide additional dining and entertainment options with live music and unique experiences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Ryman Auditorium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ryman Auditorium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Ryman Auditorium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Ryman Auditorium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
